description_en: Updates the information of a dataset
description_zh: 更新一个数据集（Dataset）的信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm update-dataset --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --description immtest --template-id Official:ImageManagement --dataset-max-bind-count 10 --dataset-max-file-count 100000000 --dataset-max-entity-count 10000000000 --dataset-max-relation-count 100000000000 --dataset-max-total-file-size 90000000000000000 --workflow-parameters example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataset

parameters.help_en: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The dataset name. For information about how to obtain the dataset name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称, 获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en: The workflow template ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466304.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作流模板ID。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466304.html
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of bindings for each dataset. Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 每个数据集绑定的最大个数。取值范围为1~10
parameters.name: dataset_max_bind_count

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of files in each dataset. Valid values: 1 to 100000000
parameters.help_zh: 每个数据集中文件的最大个数。取值范围为1~100000000
parameters.name: dataset_max_file_count

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of metadata entities (including data files, file relationships, and clustering groups) in each dataset. The maximum value is 2^63-1.
This is a reserved parameter and is not enforced during use
parameters.help_zh:
每个数据集中元数据实体（包括数据文件、文件关系、聚类分组等）的最大个数，最大取值为2^63-1。
预留参数，使用中并不做实际限制
parameters.name: dataset_max_entity_count

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of metadata relationships in each dataset. The maximum value is 2^63-1.
This is a reserved parameter and is not enforced during use
parameters.help_zh:
每个数据集中元数据关系的最大个数，最大取值为2^63-1。
预留参数，使用中并不做实际限制
parameters.name: dataset_max_relation_count

parameters.help_en: The maximum total file size in each dataset. After this limit is exceeded, no more indexes can be added. The maximum value is 2^63-1. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 每个数据集中文件总大小的最大值，超过限制后无法再添加索引，最大取值为2^63-1，单位为字节
parameters.name: dataset_max_total_file_size
